closure_rule: Start from Plans/00-plans-index.md owner routing, enumerate every automated model-input, model-work, reducer, retry, result-reinjection, provider-boundary, and enforcement consumer found in the bounded owner-doc reads, and fail closed on any later caller whose origin or route is absent.

scope.implementation_claim_rule: Canonical planning, generated validation, implementation, executable integration, and certification are distinct evidence states.

execution_class_definitions.runnable_current_deterministic: Runnable now against current repository behavior without subject-model semantic judgment.
execution_class_definitions.isolated_contract_simulation: Runnable only in the test-only controller under the exclusive root; it cannot prove production integration.
execution_class_definitions.blocked_production_implementation: The real Puppet Master surface cannot be exercised until its product runtime, gate, adapter, persistence, or controller implementation exists and is enabled.

rows.surface: Agent Packet Compiler and deterministic Packet Admission Gate
rows.why_affected: This is the proposed central compiler, splitter, coverage-manifest producer, and admission authority that every in-scope caller must use.
rows.current_evidence: Accepted ledger design only; it has not been compiled to canonical Plans or implemented.

rows.surface: Generic automated prompt assembly and provider emission
rows.why_affected: The final automated instruction/context/tool packet is where bounded work, exact response contracts, and final admission must converge.
rows.current_evidence: Canonical plan contract; no executable dispatch proof in the inspected slice.

rows.surface: Plugin prompt, system, parameter, and compaction transforms
rows.why_affected: Late prompt or parameter mutation can change authority, size, provider bytes, and route after an earlier check.
rows.current_evidence: Plan-only hooks; the owner doc permits fail-open hook errors and does not prove a shared final-effective-request admission step.

rows.surface: Instruction and capability bundle aggregation
rows.why_affected: Persona bodies, skills, rules, AGENTS files, tools, MCP schemas, and plugin contributions can create obligation-dense or oversized input and authority collisions.
rows.current_evidence: Each owner defines planned contributions, but no executable complete bundle receipt or shared aggregate admission is proven.

rows.surface: Provider serializer, exact-byte dispatch, and effective route snapshot
rows.why_affected: The provider boundary must send the exact immutable co-gated bytes and retain requested/effective provider, route, model, account, effort, and transform identity.
rows.current_evidence: Accepted ordering and identity snapshots exist in Plans; no exact byte artifact, hash-bound dispatch receipt, or executable serializer is proven.

rows.surface: FileSafe check over compiled prompt, attachments, paths, and write scope
rows.why_affected: FileSafe is the independent safety gate after prompt assembly and before provider send and must bind the same final request as Packet Admission.
rows.current_evidence: Canonical PlanUnit with create_worknodes false; no current product integration proof for the proposed co-bound receipt.

rows.surface: Immutable permission snapshot and provider-data exposure
rows.why_affected: Provider calls and FileSafe decisions depend on exact actor, account, runtime, target, data class, redaction, and requested/effective authority currentness.
rows.current_evidence: Accepted plan requirement; the inspected owner doc supplies no implementation/certification evidence.

rows.surface: Child authority ceilings and post-hook tool revalidation
rows.why_affected: Child packets may narrow but never widen parent authority, and tool arguments changed by hooks require another deterministic permission check.
rows.current_evidence: Planned runtime policy only.

rows.surface: Closed-world origin and provider-route registry
rows.why_affected: Strict automation versus the two Chat exceptions must be derived from controller-issued origin; unknown/unmigrated routes must block.
rows.current_evidence: The generic origin family is a newly accepted ledger contract; Contracts has web-specific origin fields but no closed generic model-call origin envelope.

rows.surface: Compaction, bounded later-turn history, and current-state reconstruction
rows.why_affected: Automated turns must use current typed state and bounded excerpts without losing requirements or reviving stale authority from append-only history.
rows.current_evidence: Owner docs specify planned context behavior; no strict-policy current-state packet implementation is executable.

rows.surface: Tool, MCP, plugin, terminal, search, file, memory, and data-result reinjection
rows.why_affected: Oversized, partial, stale, or prompt-like result content must be retained by ref and admitted as bounded untrusted evidence before another model call.
rows.current_evidence: Reference-first and settlement contracts are canonical planning; no universal implemented result-admission adapter is proven.

rows.surface: Response schema, requirement dispositions, evidence joins, and defect-only repair
rows.why_affected: Malformed, obligation-incomplete, evidence-invalid, uncertainty-hiding, or false-complete output must not reach a reducer or completion decision.
rows.current_evidence: Proposed shared conformance validator and bounded repair packet are not implemented.

rows.surface: Content-addressed dependency invalidation, retry, resume, and cache reuse
rows.why_affected: Source, policy, route, transform, permission, model, and payload changes must stale only affected derivations while never transferring execution authority.
rows.current_evidence: Plans contain fragmented snapshots/attempt receipts; the proposed unified dependency graph and authority distinction are unimplemented.

rows.surface: Synthetic continuation and rotated follow-up run
rows.why_affected: Continuation/rotation creates another automated provider request and cannot inherit packet admission, evidence currentness, or completion authority by assumption.
rows.current_evidence: Canonical state machines only; no executable strict-policy re-admission proof.

rows.surface: Model selection fallback, provider reroute, retry, and model switch
rows.why_affected: Every attempt must preserve requested/effective identity and cannot silently treat a reasoning setting, fallback, reroute, or model switch as the preregistered subject.
rows.current_evidence: Accepted model policy only; no executable retry controller or provider attestation is proven.

rows.surface: Document-review targeted revision and Debug Investigation call
rows.why_affected: Both automated consumers assemble bounded selections/evidence plus operations and must preserve anchors, sensitivity, omissions, and exact response obligations.
rows.current_evidence: Plan-only consumer packets.

rows.surface: Vision bridge, image attachment routing, OCR, and non-vision fallback
rows.why_affected: Image selection, FileSafe approval, provider reroute, structured OCR/uncertainty output, retry, and non-guessing fallback all cross packet and identity boundaries.
rows.current_evidence: Future serializer and future vision bridge tests; no production implementation proof.

rows.surface: Bounded Goal worker call
rows.why_affected: Workers are explicitly weak-model-risk surfaces and may propose bounded evidence only, never global completion.
rows.current_evidence: Canonical Goal contract; native runtime/certification remains implementation-gated.

rows.surface: Goal planner, evaluator, and reducer calls
rows.why_affected: These roles plan, merge, and assess bounded work and must retain complete criterion coverage without raw-transcript fan-in.
rows.current_evidence: Role policy is canonical planning, not executable proof.

rows.surface: Goal verifier, adjudicator, and certifier calls
rows.why_affected: Risk-triggered independent verification and adjudication must not accept worker claims, missing evidence, or unresolved conflict as completion.
rows.current_evidence: Future verifier/adjudicator policy and tests are named; runtime execution is not proven.

rows.surface: Goal repair, replan, retry, resume, and recovery calls
rows.why_affected: Every recovery attempt needs a new bounded current packet and visible lineage; repeated failures cannot become hidden semantic retries.
rows.current_evidence: Canonical runtime design; no enabled product recovery engine proven.

rows.surface: Goal child goals and spawned subagents
rows.why_affected: Child outputs, conflicts, stale revisions, and parent rollup need bounded packets, explicit lineage, and controller-owned completion.
rows.current_evidence: Plan-only native Goal behavior.

rows.surface: Worker selector, invocation builder, and platform runner
rows.why_affected: The Orchestrator chooses the route/model, builds the child invocation, receives output evidence, and therefore owns a high-risk dispatch seam.
rows.current_evidence: Plan-only/example wiring; no executable product runner proof.

rows.surface: Parallel workers, crew scheduling, and fan-in
rows.why_affected: Parallel child work, crew coordination, timeouts, cancellation, and fan-in require stable assignments and lossless bounded reduction.
rows.current_evidence: Canonical planning with no semantic reducer implementation proof.

rows.surface: Mandatory reviewer calls
rows.why_affected: End-tier, retry, and quality-gate reviews are explicit model work and must receive one bounded acceptance group rather than broad certification prompts.
rows.current_evidence: Plan-only reviewer contract.

rows.surface: Verification fan-in and verifier evidence calls
rows.why_affected: Wiring, acceptance, reviewer, deterministic-gate, and audit results must merge with explicit evidence and missing-disposition handling.
rows.current_evidence: Plan-only; reducer schema and future routes/tests are not executable.

rows.surface: Overseer and automatic actor resolver
rows.why_affected: The controlling AI and automatic role resolver choose overseer, worker, reviewer, corroborator, recovery, or graph-patch lanes and must preserve effective role/model identity.
rows.current_evidence: Plan-only role resolver.

rows.surface: Automated specialist repair trigger
rows.why_affected: Error-pattern detection may launch debugger/security/specialist calls, which are separate visible semantic roles requiring fresh bounded context.
rows.current_evidence: Plan-only backlog behavior.

rows.surface: Parent child-run rollup and synthesis
rows.why_affected: Parent state and final synthesis compress child events and must remain reversible to stable child/result/requirement coverage rather than concatenate transcripts.
rows.current_evidence: Plan-only; no reducer receipt proving omissions and coverage.

rows.surface: Execution-unit worker packet and runtime launch
rows.why_affected: A WorkNode child receives effective Persona, tool, skill, permission, MCP, compaction, and frozen runtime context before model dispatch.
rows.current_evidence: Concrete dispatch remains behind accepted intake and runtime enablement at Plans/Executor_Protocol.md:6103-6104.

rows.surface: Executor reviewer, verifier, and corroborator
rows.why_affected: Independent evidence roles must receive bounded target/acceptance packets and cannot infer whole-run completion from worker output.
rows.current_evidence: Future routes/tests; no executable proof.

rows.surface: Repair escalation and root-cause/replan roles
rows.why_affected: Repeated failure can launch Auditor, Overseer, High-Effort, specialist, root-cause, or replan work; every call must be visible, bounded, and lineage-linked.
rows.current_evidence: Plan-only repair loop.

rows.surface: Executor retry, prerequisite resume, and restored rerun
rows.why_affected: Every retry/resume is a new attempt after exact baseline/currentness checks and cannot reuse stale packets or receipts.
rows.current_evidence: Plan-only runtime contract; scheduler integration tests remain future work.

rows.surface: Fresh bounded topic agents
rows.why_affected: Each topic agent consumes a bounded brief, Context Capsule, relevant sources, and topic-scoped write card instead of whole histories or ledgers.
rows.current_evidence: Canonical planning workflow; no production runtime proof.

rows.surface: Topic conversion Overseer, Auditor, repair, and re-audit
rows.why_affected: Separate conversion, audit, repair, and recheck model roles require distinct bounded packets, durable findings, and no hidden repairs.
rows.current_evidence: Plan-only workflow contract.

rows.surface: Final plan integration, multi-specialist audit, finding reduction, and repair
rows.why_affected: Cross-topic reconciliation and broad audit must be decomposed across bounded read-only specialists and losslessly reduced before certification.
rows.current_evidence: Canonical planning only; the controller is intended as sole writer.

rows.surface: PRD interview/collaborator and requirements shaping
rows.why_affected: The PRD workflow turns user/source material into structured requirements and can invoke specialist reasoning outside the excluded Assistant Chat lane.
rows.current_evidence: Planning/Interview contracts only; no executable generic packet path is proven.

rows.surface: Parallel large-source extraction subagents
rows.why_affected: Large/diverse sources are deterministically sliced and assigned to read-only extractors that return source-linked atoms, conflicts, and warnings.
rows.current_evidence: Canonical workflow; no enabled production extractor fleet.

rows.surface: Extraction reduction and canonical single-writer synthesis
rows.why_affected: Extractor results must merge through bounded typed reduction under controller/owner custody; extractors cannot author the final PRD.
rows.current_evidence: Plan-only controller boundary.

rows.surface: PlanCompile discovery, analysis, mapping, and NodeSeed drafting stages
rows.why_affected: Broad PlanCompile stages require bounded worklists, mandatory parallel assignments, source/currentness receipts, and cannot use one broad substitute agent.
rows.current_evidence: PlanCompile is design-only/disabled; native runtime requires separate enablement evidence at lines 1058-1068 and 1395-1403.

rows.surface: PlanCompile independent review, final audit/repair, certification, and resume
rows.why_affected: Review/audit/certification calls and stale-resume reanalysis are explicit stages whose inputs and outputs must stay bounded, current, and receipt-linked.
rows.current_evidence: Design-only/disabled; node readiness remains blocked until intentional disabled state or executable certification evidence.

rows.surface: Testing capability discovery and official-source research
rows.why_affected: Discovery/research can become automated model work over large tool/platform/source sets and must preserve bounded provenance, currentness, and no stale model-knowledge substitution.
rows.current_evidence: ATS is runtime_disabled and does not specify an executable research-model route.

rows.surface: Test strategy and test generation
rows.why_affected: Generated tests/strategies must bind capabilities, harnesses, artifacts, commands, oracles, and flake policy without broad unverified model judgment.
rows.current_evidence: Schema/Plan contract only; no WorkNodes or executable generation route.

rows.surface: Browser, GUI, device, screenshot, and visual evaluation
rows.why_affected: Automated visual/browser results, screenshots, logs, and state hooks become model-visible evidence and cannot rely on human-eyeballing or unbounded raw captures.
rows.current_evidence: Contract-only, runtime disabled; no visual-review model route is defined.

rows.surface: Web search/read, autonomous research, page summary, and cited synthesis
rows.why_affected: Search/read fan-out, bounded pages, summaries, citations, adapter fallback, freshness, and final synthesis create multiple model and evidence-reinjection surfaces.
rows.current_evidence: Detailed canonical contracts do not prove implementation/certification of the strict packet path.

rows.surface: Requirements-quality reviewer with bounded autofill iterations
rows.why_affected: The reviewer may iterate twice and gate Contract Unification, so every call needs exact gaps, requirements, and response dispositions without hidden retries.
rows.current_evidence: Canonical Interview contract; no executable launcher or retry engine is evidenced.

rows.surface: Contract Unification reducer and auditor-cycle handoff
rows.why_affected: Unification must fail visibly on conflict and preserve launched-run/quality/audit lineage rather than choose silently or join by filenames/timestamps.
rows.current_evidence: No reducer algorithm, input ordering schema, partial-output semantics, or executable implementation is proven.

rows.surface: Persona resolution, body injection, child Persona selection, and Persona switching
rows.why_affected: Persona bodies are model instructions with no enforced body-size cap; effective identity, child selection, fallback, and current content need stable packet binding.
rows.current_evidence: Accepted planning contract; no content-hash-bound injection receipt or executable resolution proof.

rows.surface: Bundled skill bodies and on-demand skill-tool results
rows.why_affected: Verbatim user-authored skill content and dynamic runtime-ready descriptions can add untrusted instructions or oversized context and later tool results.
rows.current_evidence: Accepted planning contract explicitly not implementation readiness or certification proof.

rows.surface: Application rules, project rules, scoped AGENTS, Work Bundle, and Memory Bundle
rows.why_affected: All automated attempts share deterministic instruction ordering while delegated/review attempts need bounded Work/Memory views and protected acceptance criteria.
rows.current_evidence: Plan document only; no WorkNodes, executable queues, or implemented shared compiler.

rows.surface: Provider stream, attempt, child-run, tool/result, and receipt envelopes
rows.why_affected: Every restriction depends on durable run/node/attempt, requested/effective route, child, tool, evidence, retry, and completion lineage, but no single model-call envelope exists.
rows.current_evidence: Canonical compositional contracts exist; exact prompt hash, obligation dispositions, reducer receipt, generic origin, and unified request/result envelope are gaps.

rows.surface: Fresh-context semantic subject call through the isolated CLI adapter
rows.why_affected: This is the only currently available way to measure ten selected models against the unchanged fixed packet without claiming production enforcement.
rows.current_evidence: Construction complete but launch held pending the user's exact model selection; no subject calls have run.

rows.surface: Deterministic admission, coverage, reducer, evidence, and response scorer simulation
rows.why_affected: Synthetic deterministic fixtures can qualify the controller and exercise proposed machine-checkable contracts while clearly remaining outside production.
rows.current_evidence: Runnable only inside the exclusive test root; it cannot certify production Packet Admission or FileSafe.

rows.surface: Current Plan/ledger/governance validators used as nonsemantic source-state checks
rows.why_affected: These checks can verify source structure and governance state but contain no subject-model judgment and cannot prove the proposed runtime restrictions.
rows.current_evidence: Runnable current deterministic checks; explicitly not implementation or completion evidence.

closure_statement: No later automated caller is implicitly exempt. A newly discovered caller, route, transform, model role, reducer, or reinjection path is an inventory failure and blocks a closed-world production claim until this inventory receives a new version.
